attchmntText: AMD Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange'.
voiceSummary: AMD Industries Limited filed board comments regarding a fine levied by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The fine stems from non-compliance with Regulation 29(2) and 29(3) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 for the month ended August 31, 2026. The NSE notice bearing reference number NSE/LIST-SOP/FINES/1037 was dated September 15, 2026. The Board of Directors reviewed the matter during its meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board acknowledged the non-compliance and the imposed penalty. Management was advised to ensure strict adherence to regulatory timelines to prevent recurrence. The company stated it is taking steps to strengthen its internal compliance mechanism. This filing serves to place the board's observations on record with the exchanges.

attchmntText: AMD Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AMD Industries Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 14th November 2026. The company reported a net loss of 271.92 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the net profit was 661.13 Lakhs. Basic earnings per share were negative 1.42 Rupees for the quarter and positive 3.45 Rupees for the half year. The trading window for directors and designated employees remains closed until the end of 16th November 2026.
